nodes.label: ISR REVALIDATE constant pattern
nodes.rationale: Pages declare REVALIDATE (and optionally MAX_STALE, CACHE_TAGS) as pub const to signal stale-while-revalidate caching semantics to the Pilcrow runtime codegen.

nodes.label: AsyncValue/AsyncHtml deferred field pattern
nodes.rationale: Props fields typed as AsyncValue<T> or AsyncHtml allow slow data to be spawned as background tasks and streamed into the HTML after initial response flush, enabling loading skeleton placeholders.

nodes.label: STREAMING const pattern
nodes.rationale: Pages set pub const STREAMING: bool = true to opt into incremental HTML streaming via the Pilcrow runtime.

nodes.label: SSG PRERENDER constant pattern
nodes.rationale: Pages set pub const PRERENDER: bool = true to opt into static site generation at build time.

nodes.label: createSilcrowStore — SolidJS store bound to Silcrow atom scope
nodes.rationale: Bridges Silcrow's network-owned atom scopes into SolidJS reactive stores. Seeds from snapshot for SSR-hydrated data sync, then subscribes for live patches. This ensures the component never fetches data itself — Silcrow owns the network layer.
